x-enumDescriptions.accepted: Mailgun accepted the request to send/forward the email and the message has been placed in queue
x-enumDescriptions.delivered: Mailgun sent the email, and it was accepted by the recipient email server
x-enumDescriptions.failed: Mailgun could not deliver the email to the recipient email server
x-enumDescriptions.rejected: Mailgun rejected the request to send/forward the email
x-enumDescriptions.clicked: The email recipient clicked on a link in the email. Click tracking must be enabled in the Mailgun control panel, and the CNAME record must be pointing to mailgun.org
x-enumDescriptions.opened: The email recipient opened the email and enabled image viewing. Open tracking must be enabled in the Mailgun control panel, and the CNAME record must be pointing to mailgun.org
x-enumDescriptions.unsubscribed: The email recipient clicked on the unsubscribe link. Unsubscribe tracking must be enabled in the Mailgun control panel
x-enumDescriptions.stored: Mail has stored an incoming message
x-enumDescriptions.complained: The email recipient clicked on the spam complaint button within their email client. Feedback loops enable the notification to be received by Mailgun.
x-enumDescriptions.email_validation: This event occurs onto email validation
x-enumDescriptions.list_member_uploaded: This event occurs after successfully adding a member to a mailing list
x-enumDescriptions.list_member_upload_error: This even occurs if an error occurs adding a member to a mailing list
x-enumDescriptions.list_uploaded: This event occurs after successfully uploading a large list of members to a mailing list.
